changes: Replace failed-navigation five-required model with exact failed-launch parent scope (launch requested, navigation not requested).
Read fixed 02-launch command only through retained_phase_commands.launch pin; bind exact argv and parent-pinned stdout/stderr.
Export stdout only if valid safe JSON and exact current R9 launch-worker identity. Non-JSON output remains private; stderr only closed exception-class counters and hashes.
Read launch/cleanup/scope only when exact bounded fixed path pins occur in the fixed parent; preserve missing or unknown cleanup claims.
Fixed O_PATH no-follow probes of launch receipt, cleanup receipt, launch-scope and launch-attempted paths export presence metadata only, never content qualification.
Preserve 8s, 2MiB read and 3MiB bundle bounds, root-single-regular and before/after fd stat checks. Nested finally ensures directory close attempted even if leaf close raises.
Plain base64 envelope, no UI/device/process calls, no writes or replay. Explicit opened/closed accounting.
